messages:
nora_support: Heads-up — customer C raising p99 spikes (2-3s extra) for /v1/generate from us-east1 clients since ~10:10 UTC. They say it started after a deploy but traces show network tail. Can SRE triage?
jamie_ops: seen a couple similar alerts. p95 also bumped. Correlating with deploy logs now, but initial traces show a TLS handshake added ~1.6s on some flows.
nora_support: attaching customer sample: trace-id 0a3f... shows handshake delay then request completes. They repro consistently from client IPs in us-east1-b.
marta_net: running quick traceroute from probe in us-east1-b -> our edge...
marta_net: ```traceroute to edge-us-east.redwood.net (10.2.3.4), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.3 ms  0.2 ms  0.2 ms
 2  192.168.1.1  0.8 ms  0.7 ms  0.7 ms
 3  core-eu-west (35.1.2.3)  18.2 ms  18.1 ms  18.1 ms
 4  edge-us-east (10.2.3.4)  18.4 ms  18.3 ms  18.3 ms
```
marta_net: hop 3 is weird — traffic from us-east1-b is being steered via eu-west path for a subset of prefixes. looks like a BGP egress selection mismatch/anycast skew.
kevin_sre: routebot posted BGP flaps around the same window: routebot, can you paste the update?
routebot: BGP update: withdrawn 203.0.113.0/24 from peer x.x.x.x at 10:09:45 UTC; announced via peer y.y.y.y with community 65001:200 at 10:09:48 UTC.
jamie_ops: that explains cross-region hop. cross-region adds ~18ms RTT then TLS handshake needs a second RTT -> explains the p99.
marta_net: quick tcpdump on the edge for that prefix — seeing SYN, SYN-ACK from eu-hop then full handshake timeout and reattempts for some flows: ```14:11:03.123456 IP client > edge: TCP 443 S
14:11:03.142000 IP edge < eu-hop: TCP 443 SA
14:11:04.350000 IP client > edge: TCP 443 S (retrans)
```
nora_support: customer says it was transient but still affecting a small % of requests. they want mitigation now and a timeline for fix.
kevin_sre: mitigation options (quick):
- add a local egress-preference BGP community for those prefixes to prefer us-east peers (temporary)
- push GSLB weight shift to favor local PoP for that customer
- enable handshake-optimistic-accept on the edge for affected pool (low-risk)
Which should we try first?
marta_net: community tweak is fastest. I can push a community to our upstreams to prefer the us-east link for that prefix. Will do a 5-min rollback window.
kevin_sre: +1. also prepare a failover: if route change doesn't reduce p99 within 3m, revert and enable handshake-optimistic-accept.
jamie_ops: I'll watch traces and dashboards (p95/p99) and post updates. Also notify customers channel when fixed.
marta_net: applying community now: ```bgp announce 203.0.113.0/24 next-hop 198.51.100.1 community 65001:110```
marta_net: update: announced with community, upstream accepted, new path shows local us-east egress.
routebot: BGP update: 203.0.113.0/24 announced via us-east peer at 10:12:40 UTC (community 65001:110).
jamie_ops: immediate improvement visible — p99 trending down from +2.8s to +0.4s in 90s. customer confirms lower latency. :tada:
nora_support: relaying to customer, they reported normal tail latencies again. thanks team.
kevin_sre: follow-ups:
- Marta: open upstream ticket with peer y.y.y.y to understand why they started preferring eu path (likely RPKI/backup route or capacity shift).
- Ops: add runbook step to detect BGP egress skew for latency-sensitive prefixes and automated alert when egress adds >10ms extra RTT compared to normal.
- SRE: consider adding an edge-level handshake-optimistic-accept flag as a short-term runbook tool.
- Product: update customer-facing status post if this recurs.
marta_net: opened ticket INC-4812 with peer and attached pcap + bgp dumps.
kevin_sre: I'll draft a short postmortem and add the new alert. Jamie, can you paste the command you used to query p99 times so we can automate?
jamie_ops: ```select PERCENTILE(latency_ms, 99) from traces where prefix='203.0.113.0/24' and region='us-east1' and time > now() - 15m```
kevin_sre: perfect.
deploy-bot: deploy job #4521 (edge-config) succeeded at 10:05:12 UTC.
kevin_sre: note — deploy was unrelated; correlation was via timing but root cause is BGP path preference. we'll include that in the notes.
nora_support: Customer thanked us and requested a follow-up email once peer investigates. I'll own comms.
marta_net: rolling up: temporary community applied -> fixed tail. opened upstream ticket -> action items noted. I'll revert community after peer confirms stable path or leave with scheduled change.
kevin_sre: great. I'll assign postmortem and update oncall runbook. closing thread once doc is drafted.
jamie_ops: thanks all, monitoring for 30m then closing. :eyes:
